productLevel: Copernicus Sentinel-1 C-Band SAR GRD/IW reference browse pair & ASF DAAC metadata; not an operational real-time warning feed
credit: Copernicus Sentinel-1 data (2026) processed by ESA and distributed via NASA ASF DAAC Vertex; regional screening context after Silwal & Dahal (Zenodo 22730419) and ICIMOD.
legend: C-band (5.6 cm, half-wavelength 2.8 cm) VV/VH backscatter and retrospective LOS phase comparison. Steep Himalayan gorge walls cause layover/shadow masks and rapid temporal decorrelation.
limitations: Retrospective post-event screening only. Pre-failure slope motion was measurable in hindsight, but numerous non-failing slopes in the upper basin exhibited similar multi-meter displacement. Satellite radar is a regional screening and triage tool to prioritize field investigation, not a standalone automated evacuation siren.
